insurer: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: ₹1,00,000 to ₹25,00,000 (as per tables in wording; selected SI not specified in provided pages)

great.name: PED Waiting Period
great.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 12 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with insurer
great.reference: Section 3 EXCLUSIONS > 1. Pre-Existing Diseases - Code Excl 01
great.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are not covered for the first 12 months from the policy start date. After 12 months, PED-related claims become payable, which is better than the common 24–48 months waiting period.

great.name: AYUSH Treatment
great.quote: AYUSH Treatment: Medical expenses for Inpatient Hospitalization incurred on treatment under Ayurveda, Unani, Sidha and Homeopathy systems of medicines in a AYUSH Hospital is payable up to the sum insured.
great.explanation: Inpatient hospitalization under Ayurveda, Unani, Sidha and Homeopathy in an AYUSH hospital is covered up to the Sum Insured. This avoids a separate low cap that many policies apply to AYUSH.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the ﬁrst policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.reference: Section 3 EXCLUSIONS > 3. 30-day waiting period - Code Excl 03
good.explanation: Illness-related claims are not covered for the first 30 days, but accidents are covered immediately. This is a standard market waiting period.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of following listed Conditions, surgeries/ treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with us.
good.reference: Section 3 EXCLUSIONS > 2. Speciﬁed disease / procedure waiting period - Code Excl 02
good.explanation: Listed diseases/procedures are not covered for the first 24 months from the policy start date. This is in line with typical waiting periods for specified conditions.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: Pre-hospitalisation medical expenses incurred for a period not exceeding 30 days prior to the date of hospitalisation
good.explanation: Medical expenses incurred up to 30 days before hospitalization are covered if related to the same hospitalization. This helps pay for consultations and diagnostics leading up to admission.

good.name: Day Care Procedures
good.quote: All day care procedures are covered under this policy
good.explanation: Day care procedures are covered even if they do not require 24-hour hospitalization. This is important for common surgeries and treatments done as same-day procedures.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote:
Sum Insured Room Rent Limit (per day)
Rs.1,00,000/- to Rs.5,00,000/- Up to 1% of the sum insured.
Rs.7,50,000/- and Rs.10,00,000/- Up to Rs.6,000/-
Rs.15,00,000/- Up to Rs.7,000/-
Rs.20,00,000/- Up to Rs.8,500/-
Rs.25,00,000/- Up to Rs.10,000/-
bad.explanation: Room rent is capped (e.g., 1% of Sum Insured or ₹6,000/₹7,000/₹8,500/₹10,000 per day depending on Sum Insured). Choosing a higher room can reduce the claim payout and may trigger proportionate deductions.

bad.name: Proportionate Deduction
bad.quote: If Policy Holder chooses a higher room category above the eligibility deﬁned in policy, then proportionate deduction will apply on the Associated Medical Expenses in addition to the difference in room rent.
bad.reference: Section 1 DEFINITIONS > SPECIFIC DEFINITIONS > Associated medical expenses
bad.explanation: If you take a room above your eligible limit, proportionate deduction applies on associated medical expenses in addition to paying the room rent difference. This can significantly reduce the insurer’s payout for the whole hospitalization.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Co-payment: This policy is subject to co-payment of 30% for all claims.
bad.explanation: A mandatory co-pay of 30% applies on all claims. This means you pay 30% of every admissible bill from your pocket, reducing effective coverage.

bad.name: Disease Sub-limits
bad.quote: The expenses payable during the entire policy period for treatment of the following diseases / conditions ... is limited to the amount mentioned in table below;
bad.explanation: Certain diseases/conditions have fixed payout caps for the entire policy period as per a table. This can leave large out-of-pocket costs even when Sum Insured is available.

bad.name: Modern Treatments
bad.quote: Coverage for Modern Treatments: The expenses payable during the entire policy period for the following treatment / procedure ... is limited to the amount mentioned in table below;
bad.explanation: Modern treatments/procedures are covered but only up to sub-limits mentioned in a table for the entire policy period. Expensive advanced procedures may exceed these caps, increasing your out-of-pocket share.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
